evidence_namespace: RES supplemental static artifact evidence; these are not REA Evidence IDs

observations.observation: UWP Windows.Universal package; .NET Native Framework/Runtime 1.7 and VCLibs 140 dependencies; XAML build metadata; ilc.exe 1.7.25927.00; Universal EXE and DLL plus WinMD; sole declared capability internetClient.
windows.backgroundTasks entry point Duracellko.BingImage.Universal.Service.UpdateLiveTileBackgroundTask permits timer and systemEvent task types; in-process activation points to Universal.dll.
SDK decoded resource values explicitly describe Bing image-of-day display, live tile and daily lock-screen/desktop changes; actual timers and success are not proved by text.

MainPage resource labels, command property names and XBF strings support Refresh, set desktop wallpaper, set lock screen, Save, Settings and About feature map; XR declares FlipView, image collection/index, busy state, notifications and visibility converters.
ApplicationSettingsPage XBF contains UseBingImageAsLockScreen and UseBingImageAsDesktopBackground property paths; corresponding resource strings describe daily changes.

AboutPage XBF contains http://www.bing.com and http://www.duracellko.net; privacy link URI resource is http://www.duracellko.net/privacy-policy. These are packaged UI URL values, not observed HTTP requests.

48 named resources/52 candidates; 33 String candidates all EN; 5 XBF files extracted from EmbeddedData through SDK-generated Base64. XBF 2.1 metadata parsed with exact lengths and all declared section boundaries verified.

bounded_negative: All 33 decoded application UI strings and all five parsed XBF metadata string tables were inspected. No explicit purchase, subscription, advertisement or telemetry UI/endpoint was identified in this resource-only scope. This is not a whole-program or runtime absence claim.
limitations: XBF node streams were not decompiled; exact node bindings/control trees are not asserted from string-table co-occurrence alone.
Resource and manifest declarations are static intent, not proof that a feature ran successfully.
No app launch, UI changes, network capture, setting change, wall-paper change, target code execution or active REA target mutation.
Only selected installed package was inspected; optional separate language packages were not investigated.
Two PRI path candidates point to files absent from the installed inventory; this does not establish runtime failure because they may be unused build residue.
The primary DLL's implementation and actual backend data endpoints are outside this supplement.
